gates.threshold: widest point <= 1.6 mm; smallest cluster >= 14 texels; 0 bare texels > 1.2 mm from a sharp convex edge; bare fraction 0.3-4 % (W2: 0.07 % in 196 flecks)

gates.name: wear: charging knob bare steel

gates.name: wear: Mag polymer never shows metal; whitening only on edges
gates.threshold: 0 metallic texels; 0 whitened clusters > 1.2 mm from a sharp convex edge
